children: Abacus Global Management, Inc. (NYSE: ABX), a financial services company specializing in alternative asset management, data-driven wealth solutions, and technology innovations for longevity-based assets, today announced that it will participate in the Barclays 24th Annual Global Financial Services Conference, taking place September 14-16, 2026 at The New York Hilton Midtown, NY.

Members of Abacus management, including Head of Investor Relations David Jackson, and SVP, Corporate & Government Affairs Rob Phillips, will be available for one-on-one and small-group investor meetings throughout the day on Monday, September 14th.
To request a meeting with Abacus management, please contact your Barclays representative or email the Company's Investor Relations team at

Abacus Global Management (NYSE: ABX) is a financial services company specializing in alternative asset management, data-driven wealth solutions, technology innovations, and institutional services. With a focus on longevity-based assets and personalized financial planning, Abacus leverages proprietary data analytics and decades of industry expertise to deliver innovative solutions that optimize financial outcomes for individuals and institutions worldwide.
